core-main: Used as a section header in Special:ManageWiki which is a page that allows administrators to manage their wiki's settings
deletedwikis: Used as a heading in Special:DeletedWikis which is a page that lists deleted wikis
managewiki-changes-none: A message that is shown when people try to save changes without actually making any change
managewiki-conflicts: A message that is shown under a setting that conflicts with another. $1 is the configured conflict name.
managewiki-core-header: Header shown above the wiki's core settings form on Special:ManageWiki/core.
managewiki-core-info: Help text shown above the database name field on Special:ManageWiki when viewing a remote wiki's core configuration.
managewiki-disabled: Message that indicates that a feature is not yet enabled on a wiki.
managewiki-error-conflict: A message that is shown when a setting conflicts with another
managewiki-error-dependency: Error message shown when a user tries to disable an extension that another enabled extension depends on. $1 is the extension being disabled, $2 is the extension that depends on it.
managewiki-error-disallowednamespace: A message that is shown when someone tries to create a disallowed namespace
managewiki-error-emptygroup: Error message shown when a user tries to create a user group without assigning any permissions to it.
managewiki-error-install: Error message shown when enabling an extension fails. $1 is the name of the extension.
managewiki-error-missingpermission: Error message shown when a user attempts to remove the 'managewiki-permissions' right from the last group that has it.
managewiki-error-missingwiki: Error message given when a wiki does not exist. $1 is the wiki database name.
managewiki-error-nopermission: Message shown when a user is viewing a wiki's configuration but does not have permission to edit it.
managewiki-error-nopermission-remote: "Operator" here is someone with the 'managewiki' right, normally a bureaucrat.
managewiki-error-requirements-disabled: Error message shown when a user tries to disable an extension but lacks the permissions required to do so. $1 is the name of the extension.
managewiki-error-requirements-enabled: Error message shown when a user tries to enable an extension that does not meet its requirements. $1 is the name of the extension.
managewiki-extension-name:
{{optional}}
Used as a label for extension names in ManageWiki. $1 is the link to a page (like on mediawiki.org); $2 is the name of the extension, which may be the localized namemsg.
managewiki-extension-oneway-disable: Warning shown in Special:ManageWiki/extensions next to an enabled extension that the user may disable but could not enable again afterwards. $1 is a list of the user rights needed to enable it; $2 is the number of those rights.
managewiki-extension-oneway-enable: Warning shown in Special:ManageWiki/extensions next to a disabled extension that the user may enable but could not disable afterwards. $1 is a list of the user rights needed to disable it; $2 is the number of those rights.
managewiki-extension-settings: Text for a link to a filtered Special:ManageWiki/settings from Special:ManageWiki/extensions
managewiki-header-core-view: Header shown in Special:ManageWiki when the user can view but not change the wiki's core settings.
managewiki-header-extensions-view: Header shown in Special:ManageWiki/extensions when the user can view but not change the wiki's extensions.
managewiki-header-namespaces-view: Header shown in Special:ManageWiki/namespaces when the user can view but not change the wiki's namespaces.
managewiki-header-permissions-view: Header shown in Special:ManageWiki/permissions when the user can view but not change the wiki's user groups.
managewiki-header-settings-view: Header shown in Special:ManageWiki/settings when the user can view but not change the wiki's settings.
managewiki-invalid-database: Status message given if an invalid database is given for the 'databases' type. $1 is the given database, $2 is the configuration variable name.
managewiki-label-closed:
Used as a label for 'closed'. An adjective that describes a closed wiki.
{{Identical|Closed}}
managewiki-label-creationdate: Used as a column header for the date a wiki was created, shown on Special:DeletedWikis.
managewiki-label-dbcluster: Used as a label for 'dbcluster', the database cluster a wiki is hosted on.
managewiki-label-dbname:
Used as a label for 'dbname'.
{{Identical|Database name}}
managewiki-label-deletewiki: Used as a label for the checkbox that marks a wiki for deletion.
managewiki-label-deletiondate: Used as a column header for the date a wiki was deleted, shown on Special:DeletedWikis.
managewiki-label-goto: Used as a link label to go back to Special:ManageWiki.
managewiki-label-inactive:
Used as a label for 'inactive'. An adjective that describes a wiki.
{{Identical|Inactive}}
managewiki-label-inactive-exempt: Used as a label for 'inactive-exempt', which marks a wiki as exempt from being marked inactive.
managewiki-label-lockwiki: Used as a label for the checkbox that locks a wiki's settings.
managewiki-label-server: Used as a label for 'server', the domain name of a wiki.
managewiki-label-undeletewiki: Used as a label for the checkbox that undeletes a wiki, shown on Special:DeletedWikis.
managewiki-label-unlockwiki: Used as a label for the checkbox that unlocks a wiki's settings.
managewiki-link-core: Text for a link to Special:ManageWiki/core when the user can manage the wiki's core settings.
managewiki-link-core-view: Text for a link to Special:ManageWiki/core when the user can only view the wiki's core settings.
managewiki-link-extensions: Text for a link to Special:ManageWiki/extensions when the user can manage the wiki's extensions.
managewiki-link-extensions-view: Text for a link to Special:ManageWiki/extensions when the user can only view the wiki's extensions.
managewiki-link-namespaces: Text for a link to Special:ManageWiki/namespaces when the user can manage the wiki's namespaces.
managewiki-link-namespaces-view: Text for a link to Special:ManageWiki/namespaces when the user can only view the wiki's namespaces.
managewiki-link-permissions: Text for a link to Special:ManageWiki/permissions when the user can manage the wiki's user groups.
managewiki-link-permissions-view: Text for a link to Special:ManageWiki/permissions when the user can only view the wiki's user groups.
managewiki-link-settings: Text for a link to Special:ManageWiki/settings when the user can manage the wiki's additional settings.
managewiki-link-settings-view: Text for a link to Special:ManageWiki/settings when the user can only view the wiki's additional settings.
managewiki-mwlocked: Message shown on Special:ManageWiki when the wiki's ability to use ManageWiki has been restricted by a farm operator.
managewiki-namespace-conflicts: Error message shown when a namespace name conflicts with an existing namespace or one of its aliases. $1 is the namespace name.
managewiki-namespaces-create: Used as a label for the field used to name a new namespace.
managewiki-namespaces-create-header: Header shown above the form used to create a new namespace.
managewiki-namespaces-create-info: Help text shown above the field used to create a new namespace.
managewiki-namespaces-create-submit:
Text for the button that submits the new namespace creation form.
{{Identical|Create namespace}}
managewiki-namespaces-namespace-label: Used as a label for the main namespace's name field. $1 is additional text describing the namespace, such as its type.
managewiki-namespaces-namespacetalk-labe: Used as a label for the talk namespace's name field. $1 is additional text describing the namespace, such as its type.
managewiki-namespaces-select: Used as a label for the dropdown used to select an existing namespace to manage.
managewiki-namespaces-select-header: Header shown above the form used to select an existing namespace to manage.
managewiki-namespaces-select-info: Help text shown above the dropdown used to select an existing namespace to manage.
managewiki-nav-core:
Used as a tab label for the core settings section of Special:ManageWiki.
{{Identical|Core}}
managewiki-nav-extensions:
Used as a tab label for the extensions section of Special:ManageWiki.
{{Identical|Extensions}}
managewiki-nav-namespaces:
Used as a tab label for the namespaces section of Special:ManageWiki.
{{Identical|Namespaces}}
managewiki-nav-permissions:
Used as a tab label for the permissions section of Special:ManageWiki.
{{Identical|Permissions}}
managewiki-nav-settings:
Used as a tab label for the settings section of Special:ManageWiki.
{{Identical|Settings}}
managewiki-ns-invalidid: Error message shown when a namespace ID that is not an even integer is used with ManageWiki.
managewiki-permissions-addall: Used as a label for the option that lets a user group add other groups to any user.
managewiki-permissions-addself: Used as a label for the option that lets a user group add other groups to itself.
managewiki-permissions-assigned: Help text shown above the list of user rights currently assigned to a user group.
managewiki-permissions-autopromote-age: Used as a label for the autopromotion condition based on account age.
managewiki-permissions-autopromote-block: Used as a label for the autopromotion condition requiring the user to be blocked.
managewiki-permissions-autopromote-bot: Used as a label for the autopromotion condition requiring the user to be a bot account.
managewiki-permissions-autopromote-conds: Used as a label introducing the list of autopromotion conditions for a user group.
Used as an option label meaning all listed autopromotion conditions must be met.
Used as an option label meaning none of the listed autopromotion conditions must be met.
Used as an option label meaning any one of the listed autopromotion conditions may be met.
managewiki-permissions-autopromote-editc: Used as a label for the autopromotion condition based on edit count.
managewiki-permissions-autopromote-enabl: Used as a label for the checkbox that enables autopromotion to a user group.
managewiki-permissions-autopromote-group: Used as a label for the autopromotion condition based on group membership.
managewiki-permissions-autopromote-once: Used as a label for the option that only promotes a user to the group a single time.
managewiki-permissions-create: Used as a label for the field used to name a new user group.
managewiki-permissions-create-header: Header shown above the form used to create a new user group.
managewiki-permissions-create-info: Help text shown above the field used to create a new user group.
managewiki-permissions-create-submit: Text for the button that submits the new user group creation form.
managewiki-permissions-group: Help text shown above the settings that control which other user groups a group can assign or unassign.
managewiki-permissions-group-conflict: Error message shown when the entered group name is already in use by another group.
managewiki-permissions-group-disallowed: Error message when a user attempts to create a group that is disallowed.
managewiki-permissions-group-invalid: Error message shown when the entered group name is not a valid title.
managewiki-permissions-label-group-name: Used as a label for the field used to rename a user group.
managewiki-permissions-removeall: Used as a label for the option that lets a user group remove other groups from any user.
managewiki-permissions-removeself: Used as a label for the option that lets a user group remove other groups from itself.
managewiki-permissions-rename-checkbox: Used as a label for the checkbox that enables renaming a user group.
managewiki-permissions-resetgroups-title: Title of the confirmation dialog shown when resetting a wiki's user groups to the defaults.
managewiki-permissions-select: Used as a label for the dropdown used to select an existing user group to manage.
managewiki-permissions-select-header: Header shown above the form used to select an existing user group to manage.
managewiki-permissions-select-info: Help text shown above the dropdown used to select an existing user group to manage.
managewiki-permissions-unassigned: Help text shown above the list of user rights not currently assigned to a user group.
managewiki-requires: Text that indicates a particular setting needs something else to be enabled first. $1 is comma-separated requirements.
managewiki-review-changed: Text describing a setting change in the ManageWiki review dialog. $1 is the setting name, $2 is the category of the setting, $3 is the old value, $4 is the new value.
managewiki-review-disabled:
Used in the ManageWiki review dialog to describe a checkbox setting that was turned off.
{{Identical|Disabled}}
managewiki-review-enabled:
Used in the ManageWiki review dialog to describe a checkbox setting that was turned on.
{{Identical|Enabled}}
managewiki-review-nochanges: The crosstags < em>< /em> indicate that the text will be emphasized (cross tags purposely misspelled to show).
managewiki-review-none: Used in the ManageWiki review dialog as a placeholder for a setting that had no previous or new value.
managewiki-review-title: Title for the ManageWiki review changes dialog.
managewiki-save-warnings-title: Title of the confirmation dialog shown when saving a ManageWiki form with changes that have a warning attached.
managewiki-search: Placeholder for input to search ManageWiki.
managewiki-search-noresults: Message showing no results found for searching ManageWiki.
managewiki-setting-label:
{{optional}}
Used as a label for settings in ManageWiki. $1 is setting name or a separate localized message; $2 is the configuration variable.
managewiki-sidebar-header:
Used as a label for the sidebar.
{{Identical|Administration}}
managewiki-success: Message when the wiki request was successfully sent.
managewiki-toggle-forcesidebar: Used as a label for the checkbox that forces ManageWiki links to be shown in the sidebar.
managewiki-unavailable:
Title of the error page shown when a ManageWiki module or page is unavailable.
{{Identical|Unavailable}}
managewiki-unavailable-notcentralwiki: Error message shown when trying to access a ManageWiki page that is only available on the central wiki.
managewiki-warning-changes: Warning shown (except in Firefox) when attempting to leave ManageWiki with unsaved changes.
managewikidefaults-creategroup-info: Help text shown above the field used to create a default user group for new wikis.
managewikidefaults-resetcache: Used as a label for the option to reset a wiki's ManageWiki cache, shown on Special:ManageWikiDefaults.
managewikidefaults-resetcache-header: Header shown above the option to reset a wiki's ManageWiki cache.
managewikidefaults-resetcache-title: Title of the confirmation dialog shown when resetting a wiki's ManageWiki cache.
managewikidefaults-resetgroups: Used as a label for the option to reset a wiki's user groups to the defaults, shown on Special:ManageWikiDefaults.
managewikidefaults-resetgroups-header: Header shown above the option to reset a wiki's user groups to the defaults.
managewikidefaults-resetgroups-title: Title of the confirmation dialog shown when resetting a wiki's user groups to the defaults.
managewikidefaults-resetsettings: Used as a label for the option to reset a wiki's settings to the defaults, shown on Special:ManageWikiDefaults.
managewikidefaults-resetsettings-header: Header shown above the option to reset a wiki's settings to the defaults.
managewikidefaults-resetsettings-title: Title of the confirmation dialog shown when resetting a wiki's settings to the defaults.
managewikidefaults-selectgroup-info: Help text shown above the dropdown used to select an existing default user group to manage.
namespaces-aliases: Used as a label for the field listing undefined namespaces that should redirect to this one. $1 is the configuration variable name.
namespaces-content: Used as a label for the checkbox marking a namespace as containing main wiki content. $1 is the configuration variable name.
namespaces-contentmodel: Used as a label for the dropdown selecting a namespace's content model. $1 is the configuration variable name.
namespaces-delete-checkbox: Used as a label for the checkbox that marks a namespace for deletion.
namespaces-migrate-to: Used as a label for the dropdown selecting which namespace pages should be moved to when this namespace is deleted.
namespaces-namespace:
Used as a section header for the main namespace's settings.
{{Identical|Main namespace}}
namespaces-namespacetalk:
Used as a section header for the talk namespace's settings.
{{Identical|Talk namespace}}
namespaces-protection: Used as a label for the dropdown selecting which user right is needed to edit a namespace. $1 is the configuration variable name.
namespaces-search: Used as a label for the checkbox marking a namespace as searchable by default. $1 is the configuration variable name.
namespaces-subpages: Used as a label for the checkbox enabling subpages for a namespace. $1 is the configuration variable name.
permissions-assigned: Used as a section header for the list of permissions currently assigned to a user group.
permissions-autopromote:
Used as a section header for the autopromotion settings of a user group.
{{Identical|Autopromotion}}
permissions-delete-checkbox: Used as a label for the checkbox that marks a user group for deletion.
permissions-group: Used as a section header for the group assignment settings of a user group.
permissions-unassigned: Used as a section header for the list of permissions not currently assigned to a user group.
